mapper.select: SELECT seq_name, table_name, column_name, next_val, increment_by, min_val, max_val, description, use_yn, reg_id, reg_dt, update_id, update_dt FROM sys_table_sequence WHERE seq_name = #{seqName}

SELECT seq_name, table_name, column_name, next_val, increment_by, min_val, max_val, description, use_yn, reg_id, reg_dt, update_id, update_dt FROM sys_table_sequence WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY table_name

SELECT seq_name, table_name, column_name, next_val, increment_by, min_val, max_val, description, use_yn, reg_id, reg_dt, update_id, update_dt FROM sys_table_sequence
AND seq_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{seqName}, '%')
AND table_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tableName}, '%')
AND use_yn = #{useYn}
ORDER BY table_name, column_name

UPDATE sys_table_sequence SET next_val = CASE WHEN next_val + increment_by < min_val THEN min_val ELSE next_val + increment_by END, update_id = #{updateId}, update_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE seq_name = #{seqName} AND use_yn = 'Y' AND (max_val IS NULL OR next_val + increment_by <= max_val) RETURNING next_val
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_table_sequence SET next_val = #{nextVal}, update_id = #{updateId}, update_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE seq_name = #{seqName}
